svg.text: RQ3案例: Scope (WHERE vs HAVING) — 过滤范围错误
Q: 找出平均工资大于50000的部门名称
SELECT department FROM employees GROUP BY department HAVING AVG(salary...

g.ns0:text: 找出平均工资大于50000的部门名称
SELECT department FROM employees GROUP BY department HAVING AVG(salary) > 50000

svg.text: SELECT department FROM employees WHERE AVG(salary) > 50000 GROUP BY de...

g.ns0:text: 找出平均工资大于50000的部门名称
SELECT department FROM employees WHERE AVG(salary) > 50000 GROUP BY department

svg.text: 错误SQL在WHERE中使用聚合函数AVG()，
WHERE是行级过滤，无法使用聚合；
正确做法是先GROUP BY再用HAVING过滤聚合结果
正确→漏斗在堆叠柱(Stack)之后（先聚合再过滤）
错误→漏斗在堆叠柱之前（行级过滤无法聚合）
